code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extend each diagonal pair in both directions, into background cells.
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (9, 6, 7)}:
        pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        if len(pts) < 2:
            continue
        # Use any diagonal adjacency to determine its direction.
        dirs = set()
        for r,c in pts:
            for rr,cc in pts:
                dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
                if dr and abs(dr)==abs(dc):
                    dirs.add((1 if dr>0 else -1, 1 if dc>0 else -1))
        for dr,dc in dirs:
            # Continue from endpoints whose predecessor is not same color.
            for r,c in pts:
                if (r-dr,c-dc) in pts:
                    continue
                rr,cc=r-dr,c-dc
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc] in (9,6,7):
                    out[rr][cc]=color; rr-=dr; cc-=dc
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc] in (9,6,7):
                    out[rr][cc]=color; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out
'''
